issues.message: D10: "Fills in Title (FD15)." names nothing the scope and the flows have. A step names what a flow gives the user there; drop what no flow has.

Sign-up conflict F02.A03 has no place: S02 never says the email already has an account. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the email already has an account' that reads the quoted message and offers to go to /sign-in.
Sign-in denied F03.A03 has no place: S03 never says no account matches. Fix: Add an alternative 'when no account matches' that reads the quoted message and offers to try again or go to /sign-up.
Follow-up gone F14.A02 and F15.A02 have no place on the client list. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the note is no longer there' that reads that the note is gone and shows the client list as it is.
Tick-done gone F24.A02 has no place on the project page. Fix: Add an alternative 'when the task was deleted' for the tick action that reads that the task is gone and shows the remaining tasks.
Public frame navigation holds only one destination. Fix: Remove 'from the navigation' for Book a session and let the logo and screens' actions provide it, or add a second navigation destination.

S05, S07, S08 and S10 put Add, Search and filters before what the user came for. Fix: Move the client/project/task/session-type list to the first steps and put Add, Search and filters after it; apply the same order on S07, S08 and S10.

Sign in and Book a session appear in both the public frame and the landing screen. Fix: Keep 'Sign in' only in FR01 and 'Book a session' only in FR01, removing the duplicate choices from S01 so each action appears once per view.
Availability empty state is paraphrased instead of quoted. Fix: Quote the empty-availability words, as in Reads "No days set yet. No slots are offered until hours are set."
